variant_decisions.evidence: ASV 'the goings out of the border were at the sea' takes its verb number from the English plural subject 'goings out', not from the Hebrew. Both the plural qere והיו and the singular ketiv והיה (a singular verb preceding a plural subject, ordinary in Hebrew) are Englished identically here, and no ASV note is mapped to this unit. Nothing in the wording distinguishes the readings; the qere base fallback carries the projection.
